The Kamui Athlete Cue Tip is engineered for players who demand precision, consistency, and confidence under pressure. Turning Point 7500 Professional Billiard Chalk

Experience next-level cue control with the Turning Point 7500 Professional Billiard Chalk. Engineered with exclusive Multi-Particle Fusion Technology, it combines multiple particle sizes to create an ultra-fine 7500-mesh formula that delivers exceptional grip, smooth application, and consistent performance.

Designed for players of every skill level, TP 7500 adheres evenly to all cue tips—including playing, break, and jump cues—to help reduce miscues while maximizing spin, accuracy, and confidence on every shot. Its premium formulation provides long-lasting coverage with minimal chalking, while the compact protective case keeps your chalk clean and ready for competition.

Features

  • Ultra-fine 7500-mesh professional formula
  • Exclusive Multi-Particle Fusion Technology
  • Excellent grip for enhanced spin and cue ball control
  • Helps reduce miscues and improve shot consistency
  • Compatible with all cue tip types, including break and jump cues
  • Smooth, even application with long-lasting adhesion
  • Premium protective case for convenient storage and portability

Perfect for: Competitive players, league players, and professionals seeking reliable chalk performance with outstanding control and consistency.
